headline: Anthropic 公开 Agent Skills 仓库，Claude 可按任务动态加载指令与脚本；同期多款编排工具把 Claude Code 和 Codex 拉进同一工作流。
headlineEn: Anthropic published its Agent Skills repo so Claude can load task-specific folders on demand, while several orchestrators now run Claude Code and Codex side by side.

lead.name: anthropics/skills
lead.zh: 仓库展示 Anthropic 的技能实现：把可重复执行的专项任务写成文件夹，供 Claude 按需载入。
lead.en: Anthropic’s public implementation of task packs that Claude can load on demand for repeatable specialized work.
lead.why: 每天用 Claude 写代码的人，终于有一份可对照的官方技能格式：把品牌规范、内部流程或个人自动化写成可复用文件夹，而不是每次重写提示词。
lead.whyEn: Daily Claude users get a canonical layout for packaging brand rules, internal workflows, or personal automations, instead of pasting the same prompt again.

sections.title: 把工程习惯写成可插拔技能

items.name: mattpocock/skills
items.zh: 作者从自己的 .agents 目录抽出一批小而可组合的技能，强调可控而不是把流程交给框架。
items.en: A set of small, swappable skills taken from a working .agents folder, written to keep the process in your hands.

items.name: heydamir/unslop
items.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的界面返工技能，先标出紫渐变、发光和口号文案，再按产品调性改一版。
items.en: A Claude Code skill that flags purple gradients, glow, and slogan-like copy, then restyles the screen to fit the product.

items.name: garrytan/gstack
items.zh: 将日常在用的 Claude Code 配成虚拟工程团队，用斜杠命令覆盖产品、架构、设计审查、QA 与发布。
items.en: A Claude Code setup of slash commands that play product, architecture, design review, QA, and release.

sections.title: 同一任务里并行拉起多个编程代理
sections.titleEn: Several coding agents on one job

items.name: stablyai/orca
items.zh: 用自己的订阅同时跑 Claude Code、Codex 等代理，各占独立 worktree，桌面、手机和远程都能进。
items.en: Run Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents in parallel worktrees from desktop, phone, or a remote runtime, billed on your own plan.

items.name: Talyn
items.zh: 在云端沙箱里并行运行 Claude Code 和 Codex。
items.en: Side-by-side Claude Code and Codex sessions, each in its own cloud sandbox.

items.name: ByteAsk Cloud Agents
items.zh: 在大型代码库里定位修复，并从 Slack 提交改动。
items.en: Search a large repo for the change you need, then land it via Slack.

sections.title: 代理忘了上下文时怎么续上
sections.titleEn: Context that survives the next session

items.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.zh: 记录代理在会话中的操作，压缩后在下次会话注入相关上下文，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等。
items.en: Stores what an agent did, compresses it, and injects the useful bits into later sessions for Claude Code, Codex, and more.

items.name: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop
items.zh: 让命令行代理在后台自己接任务并跟进，拿不准时才发卡片请你拍板。
items.en: A CLI agent keeps working after you step away and only sends a card when it needs a decision.

items.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.zh: 从经验里沉淀技能并检索过往对话，模型可换，会话不绑在本机。
items.en: Builds skills from its own experience, can search prior chats, and is not locked to one model or one laptop.

sections.title: 把一群代理当成公司来管
sections.titleEn: Treating a fleet of agents like a company

items.name: paperclipai/paperclip
items.zh: 开源的工作台，用来给一批 AI 代理分目标、看任务和成本，并按代理选择模型和工具链。
items.en: An open-source console for assigning goals to a team of agents and tracking work and cost in one place.

items.name: Pixel Office
items.zh: 在像素风办公室里调度一组 AI 代理。
items.en: Manage a crew of AI agents from inside a pixel-art workplace.

items.name: Canvas by AgentGrid.io
items.zh: 用可视化画布与 AI 协作做设计。
items.en: Lay out design work with AI on a shared canvas.
